purpose: Fixed planning interface for D1 only; no production implementation claim

functions.validate_data_query: validate_data_query(request: dict) -> dict; finite deep copy preserving original omissions, values and array order; no defaults or I/O
functions.encode_native_query: encode_native_query(request: dict, *, base_url: str, page_selector: dict | None = None) -> dict; returns exactly PreparedQuery

rules: All JSON objects are closed; all keys required unless DataQuery.required explicitly says otherwise. All numbers finite, booleans never numeric.
Field enums are global syntax only; validate actual collection membership and registry flags for every field, sort, facet, predicate and projection.
No registered date fields in this v1 registry: date ranges are incomplete and rejected rather than guessed.
Only page permits fields/sort/offset/limit; count/facet emit zero rows/start zero and no selected fields/sort. Facet mode requires exactly one facet request; other modes reject it.

Omitted page fields default to unique key only; empty fields rejected. Append unique key for custody if absent. Omitted or empty sort defaults to unique key ascending; append ascending unique-key tie breaker if absent.
Predicate types follow native field type. In is homogeneous and nonempty. Range has a bound, null bound inclusivity false, lower <= upper. Equality is not analyzed text matching.

Population key is SHA256 of canonical population record excluding population_key. It includes compiler and field version, endpoint, collection, filters, visibility, not row/facet windows, fields or sort.

Prepared native request must be reproducible byte for byte. Request headers include Accept application/solr+json and Content-Type application/solrquery+x-www-form-urlencoded. No credentials or arbitrary headers.

PreparedQuery is the new v2 contract only. Legacy requests, defaults, selectors, receipts and identities remain unchanged. Low-level native payload decoding can verify retained array fixtures without claiming a v2 acquisition.

encoding.literal: Canonical finite JSON number or true/false; strings unchanged. Escape each backslash, double quote, + - ! ( ) { } [ ] ^ ~ * ? : / & | with one backslash at Solr literal layer; then enclose eq/in scalar in double quotes. URL quoting is a separate final step.
encoding.range: field:<left><lower-or-*> TO <upper-or-*><right>; left [ if lower_inclusive else {; right ] if upper_inclusive else }. No quotes around numeric bounds.
encoding.and: Zero predicates gives *:*; one predicate uses its expression directly; multiple predicates use (expression1) AND (expression2) preserving request order.
encoding.parameters: Ordered q,rows,start; page then fl (comma-separated effective fields),sort (comma-separated field + space + direction); facet then facet=true,facet.field,facet.limit,facet.offset,facet.mincount,facet.missing=true|false,facet.sort. Count has only q,rows=0,start=0.
encoding.population_canonical: UTF-8 JSON with sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False; SHA256 over QueryPopulation without population_key.
encoding.base_url: Same base validation as existing _base_url: http/https, netloc, no username/password/query/fragment; configuration owns endpoint. No network in validation or encoding.

error_shape: Raise ContractError(code) before I/O; original request remains unchanged. No fabricated prepared record on failure. jsonschema syntax failures map to bvbrc_data_request_schema_invalid; semantic failures use their most specific listed code.
mode_invariants: mode=page: facet absent; limit default25, offset default0; fields omitted => unique key only, fields=[] invalid; sort omitted/[] => unique key asc; always append unique key to effective fields/sort if absent and record the addition.
mode=count: fields/sort/offset/limit/facet must all be absent; effective fields/sort=[],offset=0,limit=0,facet=null.
mode=facet: facet required, page fields/sort/offset/limit absent; effective fields/sort=[],offset=0,limit=0. Facet limit is positive with no falsely attributed native 25000 bucket limit.
page_selector is None or exactly {offset,limit}; only permitted for page mode. It replaces only effective offset/limit; original_request is unchanged.
Validation uses actual registry collection/field flags. IDs numeric in schema remain metadata, not scientific measurements. No date fields are selected in this registry; no date operands accepted.

in accepts one or more correctly typed values for its field; values can repeat and original order remains. JSON integer and float values are both numbers for native float fields; booleans never qualify as numeric.

range lower/upper must be numeric values matching the field; at least one non-null; null inclusive flag false; lower<=upper. Equal exclusive bounds may correctly select empty population; do not reject merely because empty.
Stable sorting and one explicit page do not establish an atomic snapshot across requests.

Neither v2 operation accepts native raw query fragments, arbitrary headers, auth or dynamic schema refresh. Legacy native gt/lt inclusivity is preserved in old path; strict/inclusive v2 uses direct Solr explicit bounds.
verification_limits: Special-character escaping and mixed/open range cases require meaningful fixture tests and bounded native tests if necessary; only retained exact-ID membership and equality bounds were observed live.
All318 field names/types are observed schema metadata, not live measurements for all318 fields.
No live D1 compiler exists or was run. Legacy source and receipts remain immutable.
